summary: 22 juin : RISK_ON (score 4.9, VIX 16.78, DXY 100.93). Iran re-closes Strait of Hormuz over weekend, Trump threatens fresh strikes — futures -0.5%, oil surging overnight. But Thursday's session was strong: S&P +1.08% to 7,500, semis supercycle (MRVL, INTC, MU all 52W highs). Marvell joins S&P 500 today. Micron earnings Wednesday. Russell Reconstitution Friday. Warsh's hawkish FOMC reverberates. Wells Fargo raises SPX target to 7,950.

risks.label: Iran-Hormuz standoff reignites — MOU at risk
risks.detail: Iran declared Strait of Hormuz closed Saturday over Israeli operations in Lebanon. Trump threatened 'fresh strikes.' VP Vance talks in Switzerland 'fragile.' If MOU collapses: Brent spikes to $100+, equity futures could drop 3-5%, inflation expectations re-anchor higher. This is the #1 risk variable.

risks.label: PCE Inflation Friday — Fed's preferred gauge
risks.detail: May PCE Price Index drops Friday June 25. After Warsh's hawkish FOMC (9/18 officials signal rate hike), a hot PCE print could push dollar past 102, trigger equity pullback 2-3%, and flush crypto further.

risks.label: Micron earnings binary risk — Wednesday AMC
risks.detail: MU at $1,149 record, $1.1T market cap, EPS est $19.61. Bar extraordinarily high. A miss or weak guidance could send MU -10%+ and drag entire AI complex (NVDA, AMD, MRVL, ASML). Supercycle narrative hinges on this report.

risks.label: CAPE ratio at 42.84 — second-highest in history
risks.detail: Only the dot-com peak (44.19) was higher. Multiple Wall Street voices flagging valuation risk. S&P 500 Shiller P/E has never exceeded 30 without a subsequent 20%+ drawdown. Earnings momentum is the sole counterargument.

risks.label: Rate hike odds rising — Warsh's new Fed era
risks.detail: 9 of 18 FOMC officials now project at least one rate hike in 2026. Warsh's hawkish debut sent clear signal: 'new sheriff in town.' If realized, first hike since July 2023. Fed put is further away.

risks.label: IT services sector collapse — AI displacement trade
risks.detail: ACN -18%, EPAM -12.6%, GLOB -11.2%, CTSH -10.5%, INFY -9.7% last week. IT outsourcing sector average -7%. Structural risk: AI infrastructure investment reduces demand for human IT services. May be start of broader white-collar displacement wave.

events.label: Marvell (MRVL) joins S&P 500 today
events.detail: Marvell enters the S&P 500 effective today, triggering mandatory buying from $7.4T+ in SPX-tracking funds. Hit record $329.88 last Thursday. KeyBanc PT $385. Core AI custom silicon and networking supplier for hyperscalers.

events.label: Russell Reconstitution Friday June 26
events.detail: Annual Russell index rebalance creates one of the highest-volume days of the year. IWM at 52-week high $295.59. 237 additions to Russell 2000. Small-cap breadth expanding — healthy signal.

events.label: UK PM Starmer resignation expected Monday
events.detail: PM Keir Starmer expected to announce resignation under pressure from Andy Burnham allies. Would be UK's 7th PM in a decade. GBP/USD -0.21% to 1.3210.

events.label: FedEx earnings Tuesday — bellwether for economy
events.detail: First post-Freight-spinoff results. Pure-play express delivery now. EPS est $5.90. Bellwether for global trade volumes and consumer spending.

events.label: Wells Fargo raises S&P 500 target to 7,950
events.detail: WFC raised year-end target from 7,300 to 7,950, EPS forecast to $340 from $315. Joins Citi (8,100), Goldman (8,000), Morgan Stanley (8,000) in bullish camp. Earnings, not rate cuts, cited as primary catalyst.

opportunities.label: MRVL — S&P 500 inclusion passive buying catalyst
opportunities.detail: Marvell joins S&P 500 today. Structural AI custom silicon play. KeyBanc PT $385 vs $330 current. Entry $325-330 on any Hormuz-driven pullback, stop $308, TP1 $355, TP2 $385. R:R 1:2.5.

opportunities.label: USO — oversold oil on Hormuz binary catalyst
opportunities.detail: USO RSI 33.2, deeply oversold. If MOU collapses, oil spikes to $100+. Asymmetric setup. Entry $115-118, stop $108, TP1 $128, TP2 $140. R:R 1:2.2. Size smaller for binary risk.

opportunities.label: Short IT services — structural AI displacement
opportunities.detail: EPAM -12.6% last week, ACN -18%. Short any bounce into breakdown zone. AI investment directly reduces IT outsourcing demand. Structural, not cyclical. EPAM entry $175-180, stop $192, TP1 $158, TP2 $140.

opportunities.label: MU post-earnings if beat-and-raise
opportunities.detail: Micron reports Wednesday. If earnings beat + strong guidance: enter post-gap. AI memory supercycle intact. Rosenblatt PT $1,200, Wedbush $1,300. Conditioned entry eliminates binary risk.

opportunities.label: Gold pullback — oversold at $4,196, structural bull intact
opportunities.detail: GLD RSI 38.2, below 50D and 200D MAs. Iran Hormuz escalation could trigger safe-haven bid. Central bank buying continues. Wait for PCE clarity: cool PCE + Hormuz escalation = strong buy signal.

regime_blips.label: RISK_ON but Hormuz clouds outlook
regime_blips.detail: Regime score 4.9 (very low defensiveness). VIX 16.78, SPY above all MAs. But regime data is pre-Hormuz. Monday's session will be the real test. Probabilities: risk-on 22.9%, neutral 38.1%, early risk-off 31.6%, crisis 7.5%.

regime_blips.label: Semiconductor supercycle dominates sector rotation
regime_blips.detail: Technology +4% last week, Semiconductors +7% avg, MRVL/INTC/MU all at 52W highs. AI capex $660-690B in 2026. Green hydrogen, edge computing, fuel cell themes also strong (+10-14%). Energy the sole laggard (-1%).

regime_blips.label: Dollar strength persistent — DXY 100.93
regime_blips.detail: Hawkish Warsh + rate hike odds create structural dollar bid. Inverse correlation with gold, crypto, EM all active. Headwind for multinational earnings. USD/JPY 161.67 approaching BOJ intervention zone.

regime_blips.label: Crypto decorrelated from equities
regime_blips.detail: BTC -49% from 52W high while SPY just -1.8%. ETH -65%, SOL -71%. Crypto now trades as rate-sensitive asset, not risk-on. No catalyst for reversal until rate cut expectations return. Structural bear market continues.

regime_blips.label: Breadth expansion healthy despite concentration risk
regime_blips.detail: Russell 2000 +2.12% outperformed on Thursday. IWM at 52W high. 61% of stocks positive over 5 days. Mag 7 still 33.8% of S&P. Value > Growth rotation continuing beneath the surface.
